name: Winmate M700DQ8-EX
statusNote: Winmate lists it as discontinued. Its successor, the M700DQ9, has no Ex version.
summary: The Winmate M700DQ8-EX is the hazardous-area version of a Winmate rugged 7-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2 under ATEX and IECEx. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Android 9. It has been discontinued.

atex.status: IECEx Current (generic M700 type), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX number not published

safety.conditions: Charge only in the non-hazardous area with the supplied adapter or cradle (max 4.2 V, 3 A, 0 to 40 °C). The main battery is user-replaceable but not to be swapped in hazardous areas. Connecting or disconnecting ports, opening the enclosure or changing the battery only when the atmosphere is shown to be absent.
safety.peripherals: External ports and battery only when the atmosphere is shown to be absent (certificate).
